title: AC1009 classic POLYLINE/VERTEX subclass-marker compatibility fast slice
scope: Exercise the ACadSharp #1278 R12 marker shape with generated ASCII and Binary DXF
Verify ordered child values, compound-record closure, following-record sentinels, and marker-free AC1009 re-export
Correct test codec selection so AC1009 uses the R12 one-byte binary group-code format and AC1014 uses the generic two-byte format

method.limitations: The extra AC1009 group-100 subclass markers are an out-of-profile compatibility input. The test verifies permissive import and canonical output; it does not establish that marked R12 input is conforming or broaden POLYLINE support.

implementation.ac1009Input: POLYLINE with three ordered VERTEX children carrying AcDbEntity, AcDbVertex, and AcDb2dVertex group-100 markers, followed by SEQEND and LINE sentinels
assertions: Source group-100 marker presence is inspected through the R12 ASCII/Binary framing
Import retains the POLYLINE, all three vertex coordinates in order, SEQEND boundary, and both surrounding LINE sentinels
AC1009 re-export contains no group-100 subclass markers on the classic POLYLINE/VERTEX records
Canonical output re-import preserves all vertices and surrounding LINE records
The AC1014 omitted-specific-subtype companion continues to use the generic two-byte Binary-DXF codec
